question: Which of the following is a function of the cytoskeleton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell support and shape**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The cytoskeleton is primarily responsible for **cell support and shape**.
 
• It is a network of protein filaments and tubules that provide structural support to the cell, maintaining its shape and facilitating movement.
